verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll has an embedded Payroll AI agent, so letting users connect external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions MCP client support, tool connectors, or any way to plug external servers into the product. The Workforce API, webhooks and SDK docs are developer building blocks for building on top of QuickBooks, not a way for its AI to consume MCP tools, so they earn no credit.
